repository_policy.verification: The official 1 November 2024 North American Deere price book, Canadian product page, and cross-market AU/NZ brochure were inspected and hash-bound under research/private. No manufacturer PDF, imagery, texture, logo or geometry is redistributed.

sources.title: Tractors 6000s-9000s Less PUKs, 1 November 2024
sources.use: Primary authority for model year, base code, engine, transmission, less-PTO/less-hitch state, drawbar and selected track codes.

sources.title: 9 Series Tractors | 9RX 640
sources.applicability: Official Canadian 9RX 640 page within the declared North American market; admitted only for the model-specific 8.309 m overall length with front weights, excluding three-point hitch and coupler. The selected code 4000 less-hitch base has no rear three-point hitch/coupler; its separately selected Category 5 drawbar remains present.
sources.use: Primary authority for exact 9RX 640 overall length with front weights, excluding hitch and coupler. Other page dimensions and weights are not retained as configuration constraints.
